method: Ordered normal-size registered cells, neutral/cardinal comparison, head/neck yaw and pitch plus irises and eyelids; exact numerical pupil placement is not the acceptance criterion.

directions.observed: Front-centered face, raised chin and upper irises with visible violet eyes.
Head and nose turn right, raised eye line; yaw stronger than nominal near-up angle.
Rightward nose, high violet irises and slightly raised chin.
Face clearly right with slight upward pitch, similar to045.
Nose, eye apertures and both irises aim to screen-right; torso remains frontal.
Clearly rightward head and eyes; small downward pitch is visible only in labeled ordered comparison, vertical component ambiguous to blind majority
Brim and chin lower, half-closed lids and irises point down-right.
Downward eyes and chin with a remaining rightward head bias.
Centered lowered head and brim, both violet eyes visible below the brim and directed down.
Mostly down, slight leftward facial/iris component is subtle at small size.
Leftward nose and lowered eyelids/chin under tilted brim.
Head aims left with slightly lowered eye line, maintaining anchored body.
Nose and both violet irises face unmistakably toward screen-left; right cheek/ear exposed.
Left-facing head and slightly lifted irises/chin.
Head and irises point up-left, upward facial plane visible.
Strong upward chin/eye direction, residual leftward component near the vertical axis.

anchors: Boots and lower torso remain grounded; asymmetric strap and potion order stay fixed. Hat follows the actual head pitch and yaw rather than whole-cell rotation.
cross_row_review: 157.5→180 continues into lowered frontal head,337.5→000 returns from lifted leftward to lifted frontal head. No side swap, reversed quadrant, detached prop or clipping seen.
accepted_minor_warnings: 右上区域部分相邻仰角接近，接近正上或正下的方向横向分量较轻。
